title: Chuyên đề Despite/Although
summary: Tổng hợp toàn bộ cách dùng Although/Even though/Though và Despite/In spite of, đặc biệt là kỹ thuật viết lại câu chuyển đổi giữa hai cấu trúc – dạng đề rất phổ biến trong đề thi vào lớp 10 Hà Nội.

theory.heading: Hai nhóm cấu trúc nhượng bộ
points: Although / Even though / Though + S + V (mệnh đề), S + V.
Despite / In spite of + N / Noun phrase / V-ing / the fact that + S + V, S + V.
Mệnh đề nhượng bộ có thể đứng đầu câu (có dấu phẩy) hoặc giữa câu (thường không cần dấu phẩy).
Không dùng 'but' trong cùng câu với Although/Despite.

examples.en: Even though the test was difficult, most students passed it.
examples.vi: Mặc dù bài kiểm tra khó, hầu hết học sinh vẫn qua.

examples.en: Most students passed the test in spite of its difficulty.
examples.vi: Hầu hết học sinh vẫn qua bài kiểm tra bất chấp độ khó của nó.

theory.heading: Chuyển Although → Despite/In spite of
points: Cách 1 (dùng được mọi trường hợp): Despite/In spite of + the fact that + S + V.
Cách 2 (hai vế cùng chủ ngữ): bỏ chủ ngữ, đổi động từ thành V-ing: Although she was ill → Despite being ill.
Cách 3 (S + be + adj): đổi thành tính từ sở hữu/the + (adj) + N: Although he was poor → Despite his poverty; Although it rained heavily → Despite the heavy rain.
Cách 4 (There is/are + N): bỏ there is/are: Although there was a storm → Despite the storm.

examples.en: Although Tom was tired, he helped his mother. → Despite being tired, Tom helped his mother.
examples.vi: Mặc dù mệt, Tom vẫn giúp mẹ.

examples.en: Although the weather was bad, we went camping. → In spite of the bad weather, we went camping.
examples.vi: Mặc dù thời tiết xấu, chúng tôi vẫn đi cắm trại.

theory.heading: Phân biệt với cấu trúc nguyên nhân và liên từ tương phản khác
points: Because / Since / As + mệnh đề; Because of / Due to + N: chỉ nguyên nhân (vì).
But / However / Yet: nối hai vế tương phản nhưng đứng ở vế thứ hai: S + V, but S + V. / S + V. However, S + V.
Câu với 'but' có thể viết lại bằng Although: It was late, but he kept working. → Although it was late, he kept working.

examples.en: The road was slippery, but he drove fast. → Although the road was slippery, he drove fast.
examples.vi: Đường trơn nhưng anh ấy vẫn lái nhanh.

tips: Bước 1: xác định quan hệ hai vế – tương phản (mặc dù) hay nguyên nhân (vì). Bước 2: nhìn sau chỗ trống – mệnh đề hay cụm danh từ.
Khi viết lại sang Despite mà không biết danh từ tương ứng, luôn có thể dùng 'Despite the fact that + mệnh đề' – an toàn và đúng.
Đáp án viết lại câu phải giữ đúng chủ ngữ của hành động V-ing: 'Despite being tired, the work was finished' là sai vì 'the work' không thể 'tired'.
Loại ngay đáp án có 'Despite of', 'In spite the fact' (thiếu of) hoặc 'Although ..., but ...'.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 1. Chọn từ/cụm từ đúng
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the best option (A, B, C or D) to complete each sentence.

questions.question: ______ the long journey, the tourists were still full of energy.
questions.explanation: 'the long journey' là cụm danh từ, ý tương phản (đi đường dài nhưng vẫn đầy năng lượng) → Despite.

questions.question: ______ she had prepared carefully, she felt nervous before the interview.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'she had prepared carefully' và nghĩa tương phản → Even though.

questions.question: In spite of ______, the farmers continued working in the fields.
questions.explanation: In spite of + cụm danh từ → 'the heat'. A là mệnh đề; C, D sai trật tự từ.

questions.question: Despite ______ a lot of money, he lives in a small flat.
______ the fact that the city is crowded, many young people want to live there.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'Despite / In spite of + the fact that + S + V'. Although/Even though/Because không đi với 'the fact that' theo cách này.

questions.question: Many tourists visit the village ______ it is difficult to get there.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'it is difficult to get there', nghĩa tương phản → although.

questions.question: ______ his broken leg, Minh couldn't take part in the race.
questions.explanation: Gãy chân là nguyên nhân khiến Minh không thể thi đấu (quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả) và sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ → Because of.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 2. Chọn câu có nghĩa gần nhất
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.

questions.question: Although he was ill, he went to work.

options.A: Despite he was ill, he went to work.
options.B: In spite of being ill, he went to work.
options.C: Because of his illness, he went to work.
options.D: In spite of ill, he went to work.

questions.explanation: Cùng chủ ngữ 'he' → In spite of + V-ing (being ill). A dùng Despite với mệnh đề; C sai nghĩa (nguyên nhân); D thiếu V-ing/danh từ.

questions.question: The weather was terrible, but the festival still took place.

options.A: Despite the terrible weather, the festival still took place.
options.B: Because the weather was terrible, the festival still took place.
options.C: Although the terrible weather, the festival still took place.
options.D: In spite of the weather was terrible, the festival still took place.

questions.explanation: Despite + cụm danh từ 'the terrible weather' giữ nguyên ý tương phản. B sai nghĩa; C, D sai cấu trúc.

questions.question: Although there was a power cut, the students finished their test.

options.A: Despite there was a power cut, the students finished their test.
options.B: Despite the power cut, the students finished their test.
options.C: Due to the power cut, the students finished their test.
options.D: Although the power cut, the students finished their test.

questions.explanation: Với 'there was + N', khi chuyển sang Despite ta bỏ 'there was' → Despite the power cut. A, D sai cấu trúc; C sai nghĩa.

questions.question: Although Lan is very young, she speaks three languages.

options.A: In spite of her young age, Lan speaks three languages.
options.B: In spite of Lan is very young, she speaks three languages.
options.C: Because Lan is very young, she speaks three languages.
options.D: Despite of being very young, Lan speaks three languages.

questions.explanation: S + be + adj → tính từ sở hữu + danh từ: 'her young age'. B dùng mệnh đề sau In spite of; C sai nghĩa; D 'Despite of' sai.

questions.question: Despite the fact that the shop was expensive, it was always full of customers.

options.A: The shop was expensive, so it was always full of customers.
options.B: Because the shop was expensive, it was always full of customers.
options.C: The shop was always full of customers even though it was expensive.
options.D: The shop was always full of customers because of its high prices.

questions.explanation: Câu gốc tương phản → 'even though it was expensive' giữ nguyên nghĩa. A, B, D biến thành quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả.

questions.question: Although Peter practised a lot, he lost the final match.

options.A: Despite practising a lot, the final match was lost by Peter.
options.B: Peter lost the final match in spite of practising a lot.
options.C: Peter lost the final match because he practised a lot.
options.D: Peter practised a lot, so he lost the final match.

questions.explanation: 'in spite of practising' có chủ ngữ ngầm là Peter, khớp với chủ ngữ câu chính. A sai vì chủ ngữ 'the final match' không thể 'practise'; C, D sai nghĩa.

references.title: British Council LearnEnglish – Contrasting ideas: 'although', 'despite' and others
